summary: Select native path style for worktree inventory CLI

delivery.outcome: Select the native host path style in the read-only inventory CLI, preserve POSIX and Worktrees v5 behavior, and publish the material patch with version 0.5.4 through protected independent review.
nonGoals: Do not change the v5 schema, placement, leases, ownership or cleanup authority.
Do not change adopted copies or source pins in consumer repositories.

architecture.decision: Pass the existing native OS path style to inventory, consistent with the planner. Exercise the real inventory CLI with mocked observations on both host styles; retain the pure Windows/POSIX inventory and layout tests.
architecture.rollback: Use a protected revert of the material patch; preserve all observed registrations and unknown work.

validation.evidence: The Windows CLI probe fails with the unmodified implementation; both native styles produce valid v5 inventory after the repair.
The existing conformance suite, native governance and protected required checks remain mandatory. Independent exact-head approval controls merge.
